title: 第17章 妖魔岭第18章 神力境魔人
lines: “这个时候有人敲门？”
叶寒带着意外之色，很快将院门打开。
敲门的是三个弟子，境界和叶寒在伯仲之间，皆是聚元九重的弟子。
“诸位是？”叶寒好奇。
“我叫聂远，这位是赵一剑，他叫做何青峰。”
自称聂远的弟子说完，就笑看着叶寒：“不知兄弟如何称呼？”
“叶寒！”
叶寒有些不明所以。
“叶寒，我们几个人决定出去历练，你去不去？”聂远开门见山，直接说明来意。
“历练？去哪里？”叶寒好奇。
没想到自己刚前来轮回书院，就有人找自己前去历练。
“妖魔岭！”
这个聂远一脸期待：“凝聚我们四人之力，有资本闯入妖魔岭历练探险，而且此次书院有新任务发布，一次性能奖励上两千枚元气丹。”
“妖魔岭？那种地方，不是我们能去的吧？”
妖魔岭，地处日月皇朝北部，其中妖兽遍地，存在着大量二阶、三阶甚至更可怕的妖兽。
甚至在其中还有一处妖魔大峡谷，大峡谷内部便是一处地底魔人栖息地，简直是危险至极。
叶寒脑海中立刻浮现关于妖魔岭的一切，太虚秘录中有所介绍。
妖魔岭和寒渊矿区无比相似，但其中的危险何止超越寒渊矿区千百倍。
那虽然是武者趋之若鹜的历练之地，但也要看是什么境界的武者，和眼前这几个聚元境的杂役弟子结伴前去，说九死一生不为过。
“叶寒兄弟，我们只会在妖魔岭外围，不会有什么危机。”
聂远无比期待：“我们几个都做足了功课，若是有你加入，此行有八成把握完成任务，到时候就直接回来，运气好，还能在妖魔岭中获取一些珍贵的药草、宝物，拿回来换取更多元气丹。”
“先说是什么任务？”
叶寒很冷静，并未直接答应。
妖魔岭中，连神力境的高手都可能葬身其中。
内心无惧是一回事，有没有脑子就是另一回事了，趋吉避凶，人之常情。
“是万药大殿发布的任务，他们需要二十头大地暴熊的熊胆来炼药，奖励两千枚元气丹。”聂远说道。
“大地暴熊的熊胆？”
叶寒沉吟十个呼吸：“好，我和你们一起去做任务。”
大地暴熊乃是三阶、四阶的妖兽，基本上生存在妖魔岭的外围地带，三阶的大地暴熊论战力，大约能与聚元九重，甚至神力境媲美。
叶寒如今体内出现崭新的神骨，万古不败龙体初步诞生，他也想趁此机会印证现在的战力。
四个人商议不久，就直接动身了。
与聂远等人来到神力峰后方，叶寒发现一片无比宽阔的场地，其中汇聚大量的狮血宝马、万里穿风驹、神行豹等珍贵的坐骑。
书院的条件不错，即便杂役弟子想外出历练，只需要上缴三枚元气丹，就可以带走一匹坐骑。
content_en:
"Is there anyone knocking on the door at this time?"
Ye Han quickly opened the courtyard door with a look of surprise.
The ones knocking on the door were three disciples. Realm and Ye Han were brothers, and they were all disciples of the ninth level of Juyuan.
"Who are you?" Ye Han was curious.
"My name is Nie Yuan, this is Zhao Yijian, and his name is He Qingfeng."
After the disciple who called himself Nie Yuan finished speaking, he looked at Ye Han with a smile: "I wonder what I call my brother?"
"Ye Han!"
Ye Han was a little confused.
"Ye Han, a few of us have decided to go out for training. Are you going?" Nie Yuan got straight to the point and directly explained his purpose.
"Experience? Where to go?" Ye Han was curious.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he came to Samsara Academy, someone would ask him to come and experience it.
"Demon Ridge!"
This Nie Yuan looked forward to it: "With the combined efforts of the four of us, we will have the capital to break into Demon Ridge to experience the adventure. Moreover, the academy has released a new mission this time, and we will be rewarded with two thousand Vitality Pills at a time."
"Demon Ridge? We can't go to that kind of place, right?"
Monster Ridge is located in the northern part of the Sun and Moon Dynasty. Monsters are everywhere in it, and there are a large number of second-order, third-order and even more terrifying monsters.
There is even a demon canyon in it. Inside the grand canyon is an underground demon habitat, which is extremely dangerous.
Everything about Demon Ridge immediately came to Ye Han's mind, which was introduced in the Secret Record of Taixu.
Demon Ridge is very similar to the Hanyuan Mining Area, but the dangers involved are thousands of times greater than those in the Hanyuan Mining Area.
Although it is a training place that warriors flock to, it also depends on what realm the warrior is. If he goes together with the few handyman disciples from the Juyuan Realm in front of him, it is not an exaggeration to say that he will survive nine deaths.
"Brother Ye Han, we will only be outside the Demon Ridge and there will be no crisis."
Nie Yuan is extremely looking forward to it: "We have done enough homework. If you join us, we are 80% sure to complete the mission. We will come back directly when the time comes. With luck, we can also obtain some precious herbs and treasures in Demon Ridge, which can be exchanged for more Vitality Pills."
"First of all, what is the mission?"
Ye Han was very calm and did not agree directly.
In Demon Ridge, even masters in the realm of divine power may be killed.
It's one thing to be fearless in your heart, but it's another thing to have a brain. It's human nature to seek good fortune and avoid misfortune.
"It's a mission issued by the Hall of All Medicines. They need the bile of twenty violent earth bears to refine the medicine, and will be rewarded with two thousand vitality pills," Nie Yuan said.
"The bile of the geodrag bear?"
Ye Han sighed for ten breaths: "Okay, I will go on the mission with you."
The Earthly Violent Bear is a third-level and fourth-order monster beast that basically lives in the outer areas of Demonic Ridge. The combat power of a third-level Earthly Violent Bear is roughly comparable to that of the Juyuan Ninth Level or even the Divine Power Realm.
Ye Han now has a new divine bone in his body, and the eternal undefeated dragon body has been initially born. He also wants to take this opportunity to prove his current combat power.
After a short discussion, the four people set off directly.
Arriving behind Shenli Peak with Nie Yuan and others, Ye Han found an extremely wide field where a large number of precious mounts such as lion-blooded horses, Wanli Wind Pony, and Shenxing Leopard were gathered.
The conditions of the academy are good. Even if the handyman disciples want to go out for training, they only need to hand in three vitality pills and take away a mount.
title_en: Chapter 17 Demon Ridge Chapter 18 Demon in Divine Power Realm
